item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I was surprised to see the title and page format, thinking this was a newbie coldpost, before it clicked. This is a nice piece of speculative flash fiction. Small things like Yeren working for the Foundation make for charming additions. There isn't all too much here, but it gets me excited and imagining all sorts of things, and for that you have my vote.

I have one minor gripe: O5-18 says the Foundation is "an organization that reaches across this galaxy." With only six planets under their purview, that can't be the truth, can it? The statement could be chalked up as hyperbole for the sake of inspiring employees and improving morale — or outright pro-Foundation propaganda — but I can otherwise only see them being multi-system, at best.

In any case, +1.
